scheme_name: Accidental Death Assistance Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
other_conditions: The worker (Shramyogi) must be employed in a factory/company/organisation that has regularly paid its Labour Welfare Fund.
Benefit is available only for deaths caused by accidents occurring during the course of employment; deaths due to sickness or natural causes are excluded.
The benefit entitlement starts from the day after the worker joins the job.
The application must be submitted within 2 years from the date of the worker’s death; applications received later are processed at the office.
For accidental deaths occurring inside the factory, an accident report must be submitted by the Director, Office of Industrial Safety and Health.
For accidental deaths occurring outside the factory, an affidavit must be provided by the owner/manager of the concerned factory/company/organisation.
The final decision on assistance is taken by the Welfare Commissioner located in Ahmedabad.
benefits_summary: Families of workers who die in an accident during employment receive a financial assistance of ₹2,00,000.
documents_required: Accident report from the Director, Office of Industrial Safety and Health
Affidavit from the owner/manager of the factory/company/organization
